Do not copy Dawn native libraries from that tree; this module depends on
published androidx.webgpu:webgpu for libwebgpu_c_bundled.so.

Copied into host-dawn/src/main/kotlin/…/experimental/:

  host/*.kt          (host-api)
  dawn/DawnWasiWebGpuHost.kt
  abicm/*.kt         (AbiCm + AbiCmHostBindings)

Packages stay io.github.fenriliuguang.wasi.webgpu.experimental.* so the first
copy keeps existing call sites. WasiWebGpuHost is an implementation detail of
:host-dawn, not this repo’s public SPI (WebGpuBackend).
